about: Remote postings on Indeed's EU sites labelled by hand (2026-10-22): does the title or description limit where the hire lives or works from to a place that leaves out `home`? Regression fixture for jbResidenceRequired. `label` is for `home` (Sweden; Germany for postings on the Swedish site), `also` gives the label for other homes named in `home_note`. `location` is Indeed's own location field, never read. Real records quote the Indeed connector (get_job_details) or web-search snippets of Indeed, StepStone, Greenhouse, Lever and other boards (`source` says which, and 'as reported' when the snippet may be paraphrased); `source: synthetic` records are look-alikes written from the real phrasings. `[...]` marks text left out.
